resources.string: 1. Nothing for updates: Google Play updates this app.
2. A request for each wallpaper or live loop you choose to download. Core Builds Glyphs Pack comes from its own Google Play listing.
Google Play updates this app. Press to open its listing.

Plus is a one-time purchase through Google Play. It adds six things: your icon requests are filed as priority and drawn first; My requests shows how far each one has got; the live wallpaper can rotate through your loops; it can play a second loop during night hours; with this pack as Projectivy\'s wallpaper source, you choose what Projectivy rotates (favourites, one series or Spectra) by day and by night; and Spectra, 12 wallpapers, is yours.
Optional. Every icon, the main wallpaper collection (in Projectivy\'s rotation too) and every screen ship to everyone; Plus adds the six things above.
Price and payment come from Google Play. Core Builds never sees your card or your Google account.
